sources.verified_angle_summary: Profit.co announced its participation at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to showcase its continuous, AI-powered performance management platform. The company, which was recognized in three 2026 Gartner reports, is bringing its strategy execution platform to the Middle East. The platform connects organizational goals and performance management with analytics and AI-powered insights, embedding performance into the daily flow of work. This announcement highlights the shift from annual reviews to continuous conversations and real-time feedback in performance management, driven by AI. The story provides a concrete launch of an AI-powered enterprise software platform at the event, supporting a distinct TechScoop Desk article.
